syllabusSource.title: PDEU B.Tech curriculum handbook (ICT): Engineering Graphics
syllabusSource.note: Units and topics are PDEU's, copied from the handbook. 3 topic(s) reuse existing Prism topics, so their checked sources, widgets and prerequisite links still apply; the rest have no curated sources yet.

topics.name: Principles of engineering graphics and their significance, drawing instruments & accessories, lettering and numbering, types of lines, dimensioning methods, basic geometric drawing, reading a drawing
Introduction to projection, types of projection, 1 st angle and 3rd angle projection
Principles of isometric projection – isometric scale, isometric views, conventions, conversion of isometric views to orthographic views and vice-versa

Classification of solids, projections of solids like cylinder, cone, pyramid, and prism with its inclination to reference plane, development of surfaces of right regular solids - prism, pyramid, cylin
Demonstrating knowledge of the theory of CAD software, use of software in drawing, CAD software user interface, commands, Coordinate System, menus and toolbars, planes, dimensioning, saving of files,
Sketch entities using tools – origin, points, lines, circle, arcs, polygons, fillets and chamfer, trim, extend and offset, copy, cut, delete and others
Sketching entities using relation constrains, Mirror, Patterning, full definition of drawing and others
Extrude, cut, drawing on different planes, editing, symmetric, revolving, and others
